title.narrative: STITCH India - Garment Workers Claim Their Rights - Mondiaal FNV

description.narrative: Activities related to Strengthening Workers voices in Bangladesh. STITCH aims to create a ‘new normal’ for the textile and garment industry: a production chain in which textile workers, mainly women, can exert influence on their working conditions, and where gender equality, living wages, and fair prices, decent work become the standard. For this purpose, we will engage in constructive social dialogue between industrial stakeholders, and to achieve successful collective bargaining at factory, national or sectoral level. We unite the most important players in the production chain.

title.narrative: Wat we doen in India
Capacity to influence for a living wage, harassment free workplace and FoA, through social dialogue

description.narrative: STITCH will strengthen the capacity of partner TU and LROs in production countries. We focus on collective bargaining, L&A, organising (via social media and a social dialogue app), negotiation skills, Planning/Monitoring/Evaluation/Learning (PMEL), mutual learning, and financial sustainability. We emphasise security training for activists and organisations, including digital security. Through social dialogue, TUs and LROs will be better equipped to influence a living wage, a harassment-free workplace, and FoA.
